keyDecisions.decision: Build on proven working components instead of scaffolds
keyDecisions.rationale: GitHubReal, PRReviewWorkflow, and SQLiteManager all work - use them directly
Simple to test, extend, and compose into workflows
keyDecisions.impact: Easy to add new commands, clear separation of concerns

keyDecisions.rationale: Different use cases need different interfaces
Better to fail fast than silently return empty data
keyDecisions.impact: Clear feedback about what's implemented vs scaffolded

technicalDetails.workflows: PR Review Workflow implemented, extensible system
